integrity: Proof uses exact arithmetic and an algebraic digit-block identity; code is corroborative and cannot replace the proof.
scientific_limitations: Existence of one fixed unequal decimal digit-weight pair; no minimality, classification, or density claim. Classical noninterference lemma is not new. Plain nontrailing-zero infinitude follows from older constructions; novelty is confined to the explicit constant-weight strict-divisor family. Independent verification not yet performed.
title: A fixed-weight strict decimal digit-sum divisor ray without trailing zeroes
